## How to use this book

Each chapter pairs an explanation of a model with code you can run. All code
lives in the [GitHub repository](https://github.com/bgweber/AdtechBook),
so you can clone it and follow along.

## Requirements

Training, validation and publishing examples use Python; the bidder and
serving examples use Go. Chapters that train neural networks run faster on an
NVIDIA GPU, but every example also runs on CPU and fits in 4 GB of GPU memory.
